p01.why: The write through const_cast changes a const object, which is undefined, so constant evaluation rejects the call in the static assertion.

p02.why: static_cast converts a null pointer constant, 0 or nullptr, to a pointer type.

p03.why: The const_cast result refers to y, which is not const, so the write is valid and y becomes 5.

p04.why: static_cast cannot convert a pointer to function to a pointer to an object type such as void*.

p05.why: unsigned char is too small to hold a pointer.

p06.why: static_cast cannot convert a pointer to an integer.

p07.why: static_cast can use an explicit constructor and an explicit conversion function.

p08.why: The cast is reinterpret_cast then const_cast, and writing an int through the matching unsigned type is allowed, so y becomes 4.

p09.why: 9 is outside the range of an enumeration with no fixed type; GCC and EDG accept it in constant evaluation and Clang rejects it (Q-0017).

p10.why: Any expression can be cast to void.

p12.why: The enumeration has the fixed type int, so 9 is a valid value.

p13.why: The object is a Right, not a Left, so the downcast is undefined; the vptr sanitizer without recovery should stop the program, which is outside knowledge since the casts page gives no sanitizer evidence.

p14.why: The reference views x as unsigned, which is the matching unsigned type, so the write makes x 7.

p15.why: static_cast turns an lvalue into an rvalue reference, an xvalue of type int&&.

p16.why: 5 is outside the range 0 to 3 of Color, so the cast is undefined; I expect the undefined behavior sanitizer to stop the load of c, which is outside knowledge.

p18.why: The old casts act as static_cast here, truncating 3.9 to 3 and converting the scoped enumeration to 1.

p19.why: On x86-64 a pointer, size_t, and unsigned long have size 8 and unsigned has size 4, and the integer round trip gives back the pointer to value.

p20.why: auto(arr) decays to int*, and auto{ci} drops const to give int.

p21.why: const_cast must not apply to a pointer to function.

p22.why: Neither braced cast narrows, since the constant 1 fits double exactly.

p23.why: const_cast can remove const from a pointer to data member and at each level of a multi-level pointer.

p24.why: With -m32 a pointer, size_t, unsigned long, and unsigned all have size 4.

p25.why: The object really is a D, so the pointer and reference downcasts are valid.

p26.why: static_cast converts a scoped enumeration to int and an int back to the enumeration.

p27.why: The old cast notation can convert to a private base, and the result reaches b with value 4.

p28.why: reinterpret_cast converts between unrelated pointer types.

p29.why: T(a, b) with two operands needs a class type, and int is not one.

p30.why: int() and double() are zero, and void() is a void expression.

p31.why: The write to the const global is undefined, and the CV-5 evidence says the address sanitizer stops a write to a const object with static storage.

p32.why: P(1, 2) constructs a P, which is a class.

p33.why: static_cast converts void* back to int*, and the value is 7.

p34.why: No step of the old cast converts a Point to int.

p35.why: auto(v) makes a separate copy, and auto{arr} decays to a pointer equal to arr.

p36.why: Every compiler in the matrix accepts a function pointer to object pointer round trip, and the call through the original type works.

p37.why: unsigned long long holds a pointer on x86-64, and converting back gives the original pointer.

p38.why: double* and int* are unrelated pointer types.

p39.why: int* and long* are unrelated pointer types.

p40.why: static_cast converts a floating value to an enumeration, and 1 is a valid value of E.

p41.why: b is not a base subobject of a D, so the downcast is undefined and constant evaluation rejects it.

p42.why: y is not const, so writing through the const_cast pointer is valid, and adding cv-qualifiers keeps the same address.

p43.why: static_cast cannot convert an integer other than a null pointer constant to a pointer.

p44.why: 3.9 truncates to 3, 300 keeps its low 8 bits as 44, and 1.0 / 2 is 0.5.

p45.why: On the matrix targets the integer is the address in both directions, so the fixed address round-trips and base plus 8 bytes points to cells[2].

p46.why: The target of const_cast must be a pointer, pointer to data member, or reference, and int is none of these.

p47.why: A constexpr initializer is a constant expression and must not contain reinterpret_cast.

p48.why: unsigned long holds a pointer on x86-64, so the round trip gives back &x.

p49.why: A braced cast to an array of unknown bound gives one element per value, so the array holds 3 ints.

p50.why: reinterpret_cast converts a null pointer of type std::nullptr_t to an integer type.

p51.why: int{d} narrows a double that is not a constant.

p52.why: const_cast can only change qualifiers, and the cast also changes int to long.

p53.why: The function pointer round trip gives back the original pointer, and the call goes through the original type.

p54.why: B is a private base of D, so static_cast cannot convert B* to D*.
